error.mqtt_not_configured: Configure the MQTT integration before adding Presence Bridge.

user.description: Choose local Linux if HA can access BlueZ, D-Bus, a BLE central/peripheral adapter and read-only bond storage. Otherwise disable this option and configure MQTT for a separate Windows/Linux receiver. Presence Pair on iOS 17+ is required. Passive proxies cannot enroll phones. The panel reports missing local capabilities. [Guide](https://github.com/ravhello/presence-bridge/blob/main/docs/setup.md)
